Script 8 - Differencial ASV presence analyses

Microplastic exposure alters immune-related gene expression in Culex quinquefasciatus mosquitoes and larval microbiota diversity

Ahamed TCHATAKOURA, Marie BUYSSE, Marie-Laure SETIER RIO, Olivier ROUX, Claire LOISEAU, Amandine AVILES

0. Loading libraries and function

library(phyloseq)
library(metagMisc)
library(microbiome)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ComplexUpset)

We create a function to produce an ASV presence/absence table by treatment:

make_upset_input <- function(ps, treatment_var = "treatment", label_rank = "Genus") {
  
  # Extract abundance table
  otu_mat <- as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")
  
  # Make sure taxa are rows
  if (!taxa_are_rows(ps)) {
    otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
  }
  
  # Convert abundance to presence/absence
  otu_pa <- otu_mat > 0
  
  # Extract metadata
  meta <- data.frame(sample_data(ps))
  meta$SampleID <- rownames(meta)
  
  # Check that treatment variable exists
  if (!treatment_var %in% colnames(meta)) {
    stop(paste("Variable", treatment_var, "not found in sample_data(ps)."))
  }
  
  # Get treatment levels
  treatment_levels <- unique(as.character(meta[[treatment_var]]))
  
  # For each treatment2 level, determine whether each OTU is present
  upset_df <- lapply(treatment_levels, function(trt) {
    
    samples_trt <- meta$SampleID[meta[[treatment_var]] == trt]
    
    as.integer(rowSums(otu_pa[, samples_trt, drop = FALSE]) > 0)
  })
  
  # Convert to data frame
  upset_df <- as.data.frame(upset_df)
  colnames(upset_df) <- treatment_levels
  
  # Add OTU names
  upset_df$OTU <- rownames(otu_pa)
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Add taxonomic / cluster label
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  
  if (!is.null(tax_table(ps, errorIfNULL = FALSE))) {
    
    tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps))
    tax_df$OTU <- rownames(tax_df)
    
    if (label_rank %in% colnames(tax_df)) {
      
      label_df <- tax_df[, c("OTU", label_rank)]
      colnames(label_df) <- c("OTU", "Label")
      
      upset_df <- upset_df %>%
        left_join(label_df, by = "OTU")
      
    } else {
      
      warning(paste(
        "Taxonomic rank", label_rank,
        "not found in tax_table(ps). Label set to NA."
      ))
      
      upset_df$Label <- NA
    }
    
  } else {
    
    warning("No tax_table found in phyloseq object. Label set to NA.")
    upset_df$Label <- NA
  }
  
  # Replace missing labels by OTU name
  upset_df$Label <- ifelse(
    is.na(upset_df$Label) | upset_df$Label == "",
    upset_df$OTU,
    as.character(upset_df$Label)
  )
  
  # Put descriptive columns first
  upset_df <- upset_df %>%
    relocate(OTU, Label)
  
  return(upset_df)
}

0. Load the datasets

load("rdata_LARVES.RData")

load("rdata_FEMALE.RData")
rdata_FM_1 <- subset_samples(rdata_F, sample_type %in% c("female_midgut"))
rdata_FM <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(rdata_FM_1) > 0, rdata_FM_1)

load("rdata_FEMALE.RData")
rdata_FW_1 <- subset_samples(rdata_F, sample_type %in% c("female_whole"))
rdata_FW <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(rdata_FW_1) > 0, rdata_FW_1)

We will visualize the number of shared ASVs per sample type and MP concentrations. 

desired_order <- c("600","200","60","control")
set_colours <- c(
  "600"     = "#03045e",
  "200"     = "#5B07F5",
  "60"      = "#48cae4",
  "control" = "grey30"
)
clean_theme <- theme_classic() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )

1. Shared ASVs in larvae

upset_larvae <- make_upset_input(rdata_L, treatment_var = "treatment")

treatment_cols <- setdiff(
  colnames(upset_larvae), c("OTU", "Label"))

upset_larvae <- upset_larvae %>%
  select(OTU, Label, all_of(desired_order))

upset_larvae_logical <- upset_larvae
upset_larvae_logical[desired_order] <- lapply(upset_larvae_logical[desired_order], as.logical)

upsetplot_larvae <- ComplexUpset::upset(
  upset_larvae_logical,
  intersect = desired_order,
  name = "Treatment",
  sort_sets = FALSE,
  sort_intersections_by = "cardinality",
  min_size = 1,
  width_ratio = 0.15,
  height_ratio = 0.6,

  base_annotations = list(
    "Shared ASVs" = intersection_size(
      counts = TRUE,
      mapping = aes(fill = "bars")
    ) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("bars" = "orange")) +
      clean_theme +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank()
      )
  ),

  set_sizes = (
  upset_set_size(
    geom = geom_bar(aes(fill = group), width = 0.7)
  ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = set_colours) +
    clean_theme +
    ylab("ASVs per treatment") +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
  ),

  matrix = intersection_matrix(
    geom = geom_point(size = 3)
  ) + clean_theme,

  themes = upset_modify_themes(
  list(
    "intersections_matrix" = clean_theme + theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
    ),
    "overall_sizes" = clean_theme + theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    ),
    "Shared ASVs" = clean_theme
  )
)
)
upsetplot_larvae
